no_dummy_prefix.note: Presented as dropping a lookup the source itself calls dubious (the TODO above add_dummy_prefix); sentencepiece prepends the space, so every prompt's first word now tokenizes as a word-start piece and upstream's Llama 2 vectors fail.

softmax_no_max.note: Presented as removing a numerical-stability pass that attention scores 'never need'; expf(x)/sum rounds differently from expf(x - max)/sum, so attention weights, logits and samples change in their low bits (and overflow for large scores). No upstream or property test runs forward().

matmul_prefetch.note: Presented as prefetching the next weight row in matmul to hide memory latency; results are bit-identical, but the rows are small and already streamed in order, so it only adds a prefetch instruction per row and runs no fewer instructions.
